companyUnderstanding.ingestionSummary: CSV-only evidence identifies Clearpath Bookkeeping as a remote-first U.S. bookkeeping provider for owner-operated small businesses under $3M in revenue. Its stated value is monthly bookkeeping cleanup and cash-flow reporting presented through a plain-English monthly brief, addressing owners' receipt overload and lack of month-to-month profitability visibility. The stated next step is a discovery call. Tax advice and IRS representation are explicitly out of scope.
ingestionWarnings: Source is a CSV evidence packet only; all company statements are self-reported and no independent verification was provided.
One exact duplicate row was removed during ingestion; repeated evidence was not treated as corroboration.
